title: drosera menziesii var. albiflora
intro: Drosera menziesii var. albiflora, commonly known as the white-flowered New Zealand sundew, is a carnivorous plant species native to New Zealand. The health benefits of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Drosera menziesii var. albiflora include its ability to relieve coughs and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, such as droserone and secodroserone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
